intro: The Bay Area is a rewarding place to listen: three busy airports stacked into one small basin, an active Coast Guard sector, and the California Highway Patrol still running low-band VHF that carries for miles. Big-city police and fire, however, have gone digital P25 and are out of reach for the VX-6.
introz: 湾区非常适合收听：三个繁忙机场挤在一个小盆地里，海岸警卫队活动频繁，加州公路巡警仍在用能传很远的低波段 VHF。但大城市的警消已改用 P25 数字制式，VX-6 收不到。

stations.d: Takeoff and landing clearances for one of the busiest parallel-runway operations in the country. Best listened to from anywhere along the Peninsula.
stations.dz: 全美最繁忙的平行跑道运行之一的起降许可。在半岛任何地方都收得不错。

stations.d: Taxi instructions. Slower and easier to follow than tower if you are new to airband.
stations.dz: 滑行指令。刚开始听航空频率的话，比塔台节奏慢、更容易跟上。

stations.d: Route clearances read to departing crews before pushback.
stations.dz: 推出前向离场机组宣读航路许可。

stations.d: Looped recording of wind, visibility, runways in use. The single best frequency for a quick local weather read.
stations.dz: 循环播报风向、能见度、使用跑道。想快速了解当地天气，这是最好的一个频率。

stations.z: 北加进场管制（SFO 进场）
stations.d: NorCal splits the Bay into many sectors and reassigns them by traffic volume. Scan 120–136 MHz to find whichever sector is live.
stations.dz: 北加管制把湾区切成很多扇区，并按流量动态调整。在 120–136 MHz 扫一遍就能找到当前在用的扇区。

stations.d: North Field handles the general-aviation and flight-training side — much chattier than the airline runway.
stations.dz: 北场负责通航和飞行训练，比航班跑道热闹得多。

stations.d: Small, extremely busy training field right on the Bay. Good listening from the Baylands.
stations.dz: 紧贴湾边的小型机场，训练流量极大。在 Baylands 湿地一带收听效果很好。

stations.d: Uncontrolled coastal strip. Pilots self-announce; often quiet and atmospheric in fog.
stations.dz: 无塔台的海边小机场。飞行员自主通报，起雾时安静而有氛围。

stations.d: Primary Bay Area transmitter. Marine forecast segments are the most useful part if you are near the water.
stations.dz: 湾区主发射台。靠近海边时，海上预报部分最有用。

stations.z: NOAA 雷耶斯角 / 北湾
旧金山湾船舶交通管理 14 频道
stations.d: Coast Guard sequencing container ships and tankers under the Golden Gate. Excellent listening from Fort Point, Marin Headlands or Crissy Field.
stations.dz: 海警在金门大桥下为集装箱船和油轮排序。在 Fort Point、马林岬角或 Crissy Field 收听效果极佳。

stations.d: Tug and pilot coordination in the ship channels.
stations.dz: 航道内拖轮与引航员的协调。

stations.d: One of the oldest and most social repeaters on the Peninsula, with a long-running late-night crowd.
stations.dz: 半岛上最老、最热闹的中继之一，有长期活跃的深夜聊天群体。

stations.z: W6ASH 斯坦福业余电台俱乐部

stations.d: Sited near the summit of Mount Diablo, so coverage reaches most of the Bay and into the Central Valley. The club also runs 1.25 m and 70 cm machines from the same site — worth searching for with the VX-6's band scan.
stations.dz: 架在迪亚布罗山顶附近，覆盖大半个湾区并延伸到中央谷地。同一站点还有 1.25 米和 70 厘米中继——值得用 VX-6 的波段扫描找一找。

stations.d: Always worth a listen from a hilltop — Mount Tam, Grizzly Peak, Skyline.
stations.dz: 在山顶总值得听一下——塔玛佩斯山、Grizzly Peak、Skyline 一带。

stations.z: 加州公路巡警金门分局（低波段）
stations.d: The CHP still runs analog low-band VHF around 39.2–39.9 MHz, which propagates remarkably far and is fully receivable on the VX-6. Exact dispatch channel varies by division — scan the whole 39 MHz block along any freeway.
stations.dz: 加州公路巡警仍在 39.2–39.9 MHz 使用模拟低波段，传播距离很远，VX-6 完全可收。各分局的调度频率不同——沿高速把整个 39 MHz 段扫一遍。

stations.d: CAL FIRE remains largely analog VHF, unlike city departments. Very active during fire season in the East Bay and North Bay hills.
stations.dz: 与城市消防不同，CAL FIRE 大体仍是模拟 VHF。火季期间东湾和北湾山区非常活跃。

stations.z: 旧金山警消 · P25 数字
stations.d: San Francisco, Oakland and San Jose have all migrated to encrypted or digital P25 trunked systems in the 700/800 MHz band. The VX-6 is an analog-only receiver and cannot decode these. A separate digital scanner is required.
stations.dz: 旧金山、奥克兰、圣何塞均已迁移到 700/800 MHz 的加密或 P25 数字集群系统。VX-6 只能收模拟，无法解码，需要另配数字扫描机。

stations.z: Caltrain 通勤铁路行车频道
stations.d: Crew and dispatcher traffic along the Peninsula corridor. Verify against RadioReference — Caltrain's electrification project changed operations.
stations.dz: 半岛走廊上车组与调度的通话。请对照 RadioReference 核实——电气化工程改变了运行方式。

stations.z: 联合太平洋 · 半岛线

stations.d: The Bay Area's flagship public station. Strong signal across the whole region.
stations.dz: 湾区旗舰公共电台，全区信号都很强。

stations.d: Genuinely one of the best freeform radio stations in the world. No format, no playlist, volunteer DJs playing whatever they want. Worth planning a drive around.
stations.dz: 全世界最好的自由形式电台之一。没有格式、没有歌单，志愿 DJ 想放什么放什么。值得为它专门开一趟车。

stations.z: KALX 加州大学伯克利台
stations.d: Student and community freeform out of Berkeley. Best received in the East Bay.
stations.dz: 伯克利的学生与社区自由形式电台，东湾接收最佳。

stations.z: KPFA 伯克利 Pacifica 台
stations.d: The first listener-funded radio station in the United States, on air since 1949.
stations.dz: 美国第一家听众资助电台，1949 年开播至今。

stations.d: Full-time jazz, one of very few left in the country.
stations.dz: 全天候爵士，全美所剩不多的一家。

stations.d: Independent Black-owned community station in the Fillmore.
stations.dz: 位于 Fillmore 区的独立黑人社区电台。

stations.z: 金门大桥管理局作业频率
stations.d: Bridge maintenance, tow patrol and ironworkers. Scan 450–460 MHz while walking the span.
stations.dz: 桥梁维护、拖车巡逻和架桥工人。走桥时可扫 450–460 MHz。
